name: Nassim
description: Nassim est un homme au regard sérieux, portant un casque de chantier jaune, des protections auditives et une salopette de travail bleue, incarnant le professionnalisme et l'attention à la sécurité.
speechPersonality: Voix basse et ferme, débit posé. Nassim s'exprime avec des phrases courtes et des consignes claires, sans détour, reflétant son sérieux et son souci de la sécurité sur le chantier. Son ton est direct et professionnel, jamais superflu.

posePrompts.neutral: Nassim stands waist-up, maintaining a serious and attentive expression, with a balanced posture and his head held level. He holds the clipboard in his left hand and the pen in his right, reflecting his professional demeanor.
posePrompts.success: Nassim maintains a professional, subtly pleased expression, with a slight, almost imperceptible nod. He holds the clipboard in his left hand, his right hand resting gently on it, conveying quiet satisfaction with a job well done.
posePrompts.failure: Nassim adopts a calm, reassuring posture, his expression conveying understanding and encouragement. He holds the clipboard in his left hand, his right hand extended slightly forward with an open palm, inviting another attempt.
